name: Somber News
summary: Sully McCleary awaits you in Dustwallow Marsh for news of the King. His death has shaken Stormwind, and Sully needs to hear what you learned.

sections.title: News for Sully
sections.body: In Dustwallow Marsh, Sully McCleary is waiting for what you learned. The King is dead, and Stormwind faces devastating news. You bring Sully a note; as he reads it, his expression darkens.

faq.answer: Sully McCleary is waiting in Dustwallow Marsh to hear what you learned.
The King died during an escape attempt, shortly before the naga attacked.
You bring Sully a note with what you learned.
Sully's expression darkens as he reads the note, and he calls the news terrible.
